name: GL transition (shape wipe over a cut)
retention: A shaped wipe in the brand colour hides the cut and resets the eye; a new shape each time keeps cuts from feeling repeated.
example: And that's just the first one. Here's the second.
credit: Shaders adapted from gl-transitions (MIT) transitions/*.glsl@66a9759; modified (wrapped for RestorffCut's seek-per-frame runtime)
notes: Centre the clip on the cut (cover mode holds full cover for `hold` s at the middle). 16 shapes work in cover/in/out; the 11 distortion ones (cube, swirl, pixelize, ripple, cross-zoom…) need mode images with two pictures and are refused otherwise. renderS measured: 3.8 s cold / 2.2 s warm for 1 s at 1080x1920 (scout, 2026-10-24).
